author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: In Log Center > Log Sending, send to the data collector in BSD (RFC 3164) format and include the Connection category. DSM sign-in successes and failures go to Auth; every other line is left to the parsers already in the tenant. Synology doesn't publish its log messages, so this entry covers only the sign-in lines shown in Synology's failed login article and in public third-party guides (linked), and other admin and security events aren't covered. Check a few of your own lines with Parse Message first. The BSD syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13.
